حَوْقَلَةٌ A soft, or flaccid, penis; (S, K;) as also ↓ حَوْقَلٌ : (TA:) or the latter signifies [simply] a penis: (K:) the former, accord. to Abu-l-Ghowth, signifies the penis of an old man who is languid in respect of the venereal faculty: some of those of post-classical times pronounce it with ف. (S.) ―
-b2- A flask, or bottle, (قَارُورَةٌ,) with a long neck, used by the water-carrier: (K:) app. formed by substitution [of ق for ج,] from حَوْجَلَةٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
